description: This source file defines functions for configuring command-line interface (CLI) options for a Radio Unit Open Fronthaul (RU OFH) schema, including parameters for base cell configuration, cell configuration, logging, CPU affinities, expert execution, HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer), and metrics. It also includes functions to set up subcommands and validate input parameters, with conditional support for DPDK.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_ofh_base_cell_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for base cell parameters such as bandwidth and timing parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_ofh_cells_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for cell-specific parameters, overwriting default base cell configuration.

methods.name: configure_cli11_cell_affinity_args
methods.description: Configures CPU affinity options for RU cell tasks.

methods.name: configure_cli11_expert_execution_args
methods.description: Configures CPU affinity and thread options for expert execution mode.

methods.name: configure_cli11_hal_args
methods.description: Configures HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) options if DPDK is available.

methods.name: configure_cli11_metrics_args
methods.description: Configures metrics options for the Radio Unit.

methods.name: configure_cli11_with_ru_ofh_config_schema
methods.description: Main function to set up CLI subcommands for RU OFH configuration, logging, expert execution, HAL, and metrics.

methods.name: manage_hal_optional
methods.description: Resets and disables HAL configuration if the 'hal' subcommand is not used.

methods.name: autoderive_ru_ofh_parameters_after_parsing
methods.description: Post-parsing function to manage optional HAL configuration based on DPDK support.
